|errata_history={{Card errata/You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V)}}
This is version PC-E1 (2 of 2), 10 August 2025. This is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' ([[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V)]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-yw-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. The title prints a uniqueness dot: “•You Will Go To The Dagobah System”. Text: “LOST: Take [Dagobah] Luke into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber into hand. [Immune to Sense.] STARTING: If your [Dagobah] objective on table, deploy two Effects (except Wokling) that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of 10 August 2025<ref name="ht-yw-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3c0adde/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3c0adde 3c0adde] (10 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: the uniqueness dot is removed from the title (“•You Will Go To The Dagobah System” becomes “You Will Go To The Dagobah System”). Game text unchanged. Text: “LOST: Take [Dagobah] Luke into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber into hand. [Immune to Sense.] STARTING: If your [Dagobah] objective on table, deploy two Effects (except Wokling) that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.”
What changed on the card image (crops of the two published images, unchanged pixels):
<gallery mode="nolines" heights="160px" widths="300px">
File:V25-L-youwillgotothedagobahsystem-2025-08-07-to-2025-08-10-before.png|before (7 August 2025)
File:V25-L-youwillgotothedagobahsystem-2025-08-07-to-2025-08-10-after.png|after (10 August 2025)
</gallery>
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
*: The lower part of this version's card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was also printed as a partial slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 9, file created 10 August 2025, with the same words ([[:File:V25-L-youwillgotothedagobahsystem-2025-08-10-sheet-slip.png|slip]]); the slip prints no errata mark. The slip's area is the same on the Original image, which differs only in the uniqueness dot of the title, outside the slip. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and the card image are one version, on this page.
